Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.draftNotice: Draft: this text must be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
Privacy.intro: This page explains which personal data we collect when you order from a farm on this platform, why we collect it, and your rights under Albanian Law No. 124/2024 "On personal data protection" and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

who.title: Who processes your data
who.body: The farm you order from is responsible for your order data. The platform stores and processes this data on the farm's behalf.

data.title: What data we collect
data.body: Your first and last name, email, phone number, the delivery addresses you save, your orders (products, quantities, prices) and the notes you write to the farmer.

why.title: Why we use it
why.body: To prepare and deliver your orders, to contact you about your order and to send you notifications about its status. The legal basis is the performance of the contract (your order) with you.

share.title: Who we share it with
share.body: Only with the farm you order from and with our technical providers (data hosting and email delivery), on servers inside the European Union. We never sell your data.

keep.title: How long we keep it
keep.body: For as long as you have an account. Orders may be kept longer, in anonymised form, for the farm's accounting obligations.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data, and object to its processing. You can delete your account from the "My account" page or contact us. You also have the right to complain to the Albanian Information and Data Protection Commissioner.
